cards.title: Express a reason simply
cards.coreMeaning: Give a clear reason for a recommendation or opinion.
cards.recallPrompt: How can I give a simple reason without a template?
examples: This is important because it affects daily life.

cards.title: Turn a Chinese idea into simple English
cards.coreMeaning: Split a Chinese idea into meaning units and express each unit with usable English.
cards.recallPrompt: What does the Chinese idea require me to say before I choose English words?
examples: More and more people depend on the Internet, but we should also pay attention to its negative effects.

cards.title: Preserve logic while changing Chinese word order
cards.coreMeaning: Reorder English clauses into natural Chinese without losing negation, concession, cause, or comparison.
cards.recallPrompt: Which logic relations must remain visible after translation?
examples: 尽管这项政策并不完美，但由于地方办事机构现在会在线共享信息，它比过去更方便更多人获得公共服务。

cards.title: Check agreement before adding complex style
cards.coreMeaning: Correct a basic grammar error while keeping a clear sentence simple.
cards.recallPrompt: Is the problem grammar, meaning, or only a preference for a different style?
examples: The development of the Internet has made communication easier.

examples.prompt: Express a balanced view about Internet use.
examples.sourceIdea: 越来越多的人依赖互联网，但我们也应该注意它的负面影响。
intentUnits: more people depend on the Internet
we should also pay attention to its negative effects
examples.recommendedText: More and more people depend on the Internet, but we should also pay attention to its negative effects.
meaningUnitsPreserved: more people depend on the Internet
we should also pay attention to its negative effects

examples.prompt: State how technology affects daily life.
examples.originalText: The rapid advancement of modern technology has exerted a considerable influence on contemporary society.
examples.recommendedText: Modern technology is developing quickly and has a great influence on society.
intentUnits: technology has a strong influence on society
meaningUnitsPreserved: technology has a strong influence on society

examples.prompt: Give a simple recommendation about time management.
examples.originalText: Students should manage their time well.
examples.recommendedText: Students should manage their time well.
intentUnits: students should manage their time well
meaningUnitsPreserved: students should manage their time well
examples.preserveReason: The sentence is grammatical, natural, complete, and already easy to reuse.

examples.sourceText: Although the policy is not perfect, it has made it easier for more people to access public services than before because local offices now share information online.
examples.mainClause: it has made it easier for more people to access public services than before
meaningUnits: more people can access public services more easily than before
local offices now share information online
preservedMeaningUnits: more people can access public services more easily than before
local offices now share information online
examples.recommendedTranslation: 尽管这项政策并不完美，但由于地方办事机构现在会在线共享信息，它比过去更方便更多人获得公共服务。
alternativeTranslations: 虽然这项政策并非完美，但地方机构在线共享信息后，更多人比以前更容易获得公共服务。

writingRevisions.original: The development of Internet has make communication easier.
writingRevisions.recommended: The development of the Internet has made communication easier.
writingRevisions.reason: Add the article used for this established noun phrase and change make to the past participle after has. The clear structure is retained.

writingRevisions.original: Students should manage their time well.
writingRevisions.recommended: Students should manage their time well.
writingRevisions.reason: The sentence is correct and natural; changing it only to use a more advanced phrase would add learning burden without evidence of improvement.

translationDiagnostics.diagnosis: The Chinese phrase changes not perfect into very good, so the source's negative qualification is lost.
translationDiagnostics.recommendation: 保留‘并不完美’或‘并非完美’，再根据上下文调整语序。
